name: Christianity Today

summary.text: Christianity Today was founded in 1956 by Billy Graham, L. Nelson Bell and others, with Carl F. H. Henry as first editor. The Philanthropy Roundtable says J. Howard Pew contributed $150,000 to launch it and paid most of the cost of sending it free to nearly every member of the clergy in North America; an Enterprise & Society article describes the magazine as receiving financial support and institutional direction from Pew.

sources.title: Christianity Today, J. Howard Pew, and the Business of Conservative Evangelicalism
